//: Versions come from Conventional Commit subjects: squash-merge only, PR titles linted by ci.yml. One release PR per lane: a combined PR carrying only the product release is never tagged (release-please treats a single component-less release as standalone and matches it against the branch's component, which a combined branch lacks), and every later run then aborts on the untagged PR. always-update rebuilds every open release PR from main on each run: by default a PR whose notes did not change keeps its stale manifest and conflicts once a sibling lane releases.

..//: The product version, shared by backend, frontend and desktop. pyproject.toml is the anchor: server_version() reads it. uv.lock and Cargo.lock are not addressable by jsonpath and self-heal on the next lock.
..//exclude-paths: The root matches every file, so paths that version on their own or ship no version are excluded.

plugin.//: Tools and channel packages share this version. The nested `openclaw.version` blocks are stamped by release.yml at publish: one updater per path.

apps/mobile.//: scripts/sync_native_versions.py mirrors this into the native projects.
